name: Ryuu no Hanazono
source:
Hero comes back to his hometown to reunite with his childhood friend. However, the girl only leaves a note "Dragon flower garden" and disappears. Hero comes to her school to learn about her whereabouts.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/06/vn-of-month-september-1992.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公回到故乡，准备与青梅竹马重逢。然而，女孩只留下一张写着“龙之花园”的字条，随后便消失无踪。为了查明她的去向，主人公来到她就读的学校。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/06/vn-of-month-september-1992.html]vndbreview[/url]]
